svg.title: AED pads and safety companion card
svg.desc: A working Australian AED companion card. It covers bare-chest contact, removal of only the moisture or excessive hair needed for pad contact, medication-patch removal, eight-centimetre clearance from an implanted device, adult and paediatric pad modes, and front-back placement when pads might touch.
svg.text: AED pads and safety
FOLLOW THE ACTUAL AED AND PAD PICTURES
Clinical review outstanding. Follow the device, pad pictures and 000.
Keep CPR pauses short. Do not delay a shock to study this card.
Not for a newborn immediately after birth.
1 MAKE ONLY THE CONTACT NEEDED
Expose the chest. Remove only moisture or excess hair
needed for firm pad contact. Minimise delay.
2 CHECK PATCHES AND IMPLANTED DEVICES
Do not place a pad over a medication patch.
Remove the patch; wipe the area before pad placement.
Keep a pad at least 8 cm from an implanted medical device.
3 CHOOSE THE AED MODE AND PADS
Older than 8: a standard adult AED and pads are suitable.
Under 8, including infants: paediatric pads and mode are preferred.
If unavailable, standard adult pads are reasonable.
Exactly age 8: follow the device label, AED prompts and 000.
4 NEVER LET THE PADS TOUCH
If pads may touch on the chest, follow their pictures and prompts.
Put one on the upper back between the shoulder blades;
put the other on the front of the chest.
WORKING DRAFT — companion card; clinical and stressed-reader review outstanding
